test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits to the immediate left of C. E sits third to the right of D. D is an immediate neighbour of C. B is an immediate neighbour of both E and F. Who sits to the immediate right of F?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information is as:

1. A sits to the immediate left of C and D is an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f88345677a8f0a2fd632b31b99cbe0c908521fd909eacc5ec85827486c76d9.png] 

2. E sits third to the right of D and B is an immediate neighbour of both E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10f23dc56b806f86f92e916164ba826d618a912166d38316e71619daceaa6773.png] 

Here, **B **sits to the immediate right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
